caption: Complete quantum cost over the registered numerical-rival precision pool. Panel headings give asset count, common volatility $\lambda$ and loading multiplier $c$. Columns and rows are the address widths $b_A$ and $b_G$ of $P(m_A)$ and $P(m_G)$; all remaining scalar widths and financial inputs are fixed. Colour and cell labels show the complete selected T cap divided by the cheapest admitted numerical cap in that panel, with a shared logarithmic colour scale. Labels are rounded to three decimals; exact integer costs and rational ratios are retained. Grey crosses mark the twelve rejected monetary budgets, for which no admissible complete T cap is asserted. The outlined cell identifies the exact numerical minimum, $b_A=b_G=10$. Orange footers compare the separately fixed interval encoding with that strengthened minimum. All alternatives use radius $0.01$ and per-price failure allowance $1/3600$. These are deterministic logical resource caps, not statistical cost intervals, price estimates or device timings.
